patterns.note: A single, large, full-bleed hero image appears and disappears as the user scrolls, transitioning from a completely black screen to reveal the image, then back to black.
Extreme full-bleed imagery dominates the visible content, with no discernible text or UI elements in the initial view, creating a highly immersive and minimal presentation.
The primary background is absolute black, creating a stark, high-contrast canvas for the single muted, high-fidelity product image.

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-triggered system (likely locomotive-scroll) to reveal and hide a large hero image, transitioning from a black canvas with an opacity or position change. Other elements may animate using CSS keyframes, but are not visible in the provided sequence.
